decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be accessed through Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to create a powerful synergy with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The creatures in the deck serve various purposes, such as gaining life, draining opponents, providing mana acceleration, and generating value through sacrifice effects. The main goal is to create a board state where Yawgmoth can easily generate card advantage and control the game while also utilizing Grist, the Hunger Tide as a versatile threat and value engine.

The Elemental creatures in this deck work together with control spells and cards that provide additional value when they enter the battlefield. The focus is on exploiting the synergy between the Elementals and the control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also building a strong board presence. Yorion, the companion, helps to maximize the value of the deck by flickering multiple permanents at once. Overall, the deck seeks to dominate the game through a combination of disruption, board presence, and value generation.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggression and maximizing the potential of Cascade triggers. By playing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the goal is to consistently put pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Force of Negation helps to control the board and protect your own threats. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while utilizing the Cascade mechanics to gain tempo and stay ahead of the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively cast spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into impactful spells such as Colossal Skyturtle and Cryptic Command, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield. The inclusion of Counterspells like Force of Negation and Archmage's Charm allows the deck to protect its threats while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the land base includes versatile lands like Otawara, Soaring City to further support the deck's strategy.

The deck revolves around ramping up mana quickly to play powerful lands and creatures, ultimately leading to an overwhelming board state and combo finish. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to combo off and overwhelm opponents with large creatures and land synergies. The deck also incorporates utility lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to provide additional advantages and win conditions. By efficiently ramping up and utilizing its powerful lands and creatures, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory through its combo potential.

The deck focuses on using creatures with enter the battlefield effects and sacrificing them for value, while utilizing tutors like Eladamri's Call and Chord of Calling to find the necessary pieces. Aether Vial and Eldritch Evolution help cheat out creatures for combos, while cards like Gilded Goose and Prosperous Innkeeper provide mana acceleration. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as a key piece in sacrificing and drawing cards, with other creatures like Geralf's Messenger and Zulaport Cutthroat serving as win conditions. The mana base is designed to support the toolbox strategy with access to different colored mana sources.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through your cards quickly to fill up your graveyard with creature cards, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield. This combo can quickly overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures, especially when paired with disruptive cards like Grief and Force of Negation. The deck also includes a mix of creatures with cycling abilities to help dig for combo pieces, as well as some control elements to protect your combo and disrupt your opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain tempo and control the game by utilizing a mix of cheap and efficient spells like Unholy Heat, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspell. With creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards such as Spell Pierce and Archmage's Charm. The deck also features card selection and mana fixing through Sleight of Hand, Expressive Iteration, and Mishra's Bauble to ensure smooth gameplay and maximize its aggressive potential.

This deck focuses on ramping quickly to get powerful lands and creatures on the battlefield, allowing for explosive plays and combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor, the deck can create massive amounts of mana and take advantage of powerful land abilities like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck also includes ways to search for key pieces and protect its combo with cards like Summoner's Pact and Cavern of Souls. With careful resource management and planning, this deck can quickly win games with its powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo to generate immense mana ramp and achieve a powerful board state quickly. By utilizing cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, Primeval Titan, and Amulet of Vigor, the deck can generate large amounts of mana and set up devastating plays. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Tolaria West to search for key pieces and maximize efficiency. With the ability to quickly ramp into powerhouse threats, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in a short amount of time.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to play powerful creatures like Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to use Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for extra mana, allowing for explosive plays and gaining advantages through land recursion with cards like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Tolaria West to search for key pieces and provide flexibility in different game situations.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using high-impact red cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a strong board presence. Cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void can shut down opponent's mana base and spells, while powerful Planeswalkers like Chandra and Karn provide additional value and threats. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Bonecrusher Giant and Fury, along with solid creatures like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and finish off the opponent with big red threats.

The deck focuses on assembling a versatile toolbox of creatures that can be fetched with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to create powerful synergy. The key strategy is to use Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to sacrifice creatures for value, generating card advantage, and draining opponents through abilities like Blood Artist. The deck also capitalizes on persist creatures like Geralf's Messenger and Young Wolf to create recurring threats. The mana base and ramp provided by Ignoble Hierarch and Birds of Paradise enable consistency and flexibility in executing the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer to control the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Expedition Map to find and utilize powerful lands like Urza's Tower to generate massive amounts of mana and pull ahead in the game. Ultimately, the deck aims to aggressively deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap and efficient spells to control the board and clear the way for aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck focuses on tempo plays and card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration and Archmage's Charm, while also having access to powerful removal in Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. With a mix of counterspells and versatile threats, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them to win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and equipment to quickly attack the opponent, while also utilizing blink effects to gain additional value from entering the battlefield abilities. By utilizing cards like Eldrazi Displacer and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can repeatedly exile and return creatures for added disruption. The deck also includes protection in the form of Giver of Runes and Burrenton Forge-Tender to keep key threats safe. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful equipment, supported by blink effects for added versatility.
